sentences.text:
Praveen Kumar Chaubey And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3
Others on 16 February, 2023

Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 43
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7186 of 2022
Petitioner :- Praveen Kumar Chaubey And 4 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Upendra Upadhyay,Jayant Dwivedi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Bal Krishna Pandey
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioners even in the revised call.

This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari, quashing

the
impugned F.I.R. dated 27.04.2022 lodged by the respondent no. 4 registered as Case
Crime No. 06 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.-
Mahila Thana, District- Sonbhadra.
Praveen Kumar Chaubey And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 February, 2023

(B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus, directing the respondent no. 2 & 3 not to take any coercive action against the petitioners to arrest him in pursuance to the impugned F.I.R. dated 27.04.2022 lodged by the respondent no. 4 registered as Case Crime No. 06 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District- Sonbhadra."
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.

Order Date :- 16.2.2023 Virendra  Praveen Kumar Chaubey And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185852149/
